0022600180.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 3-0 at home) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-3, 1-2 on the road) in the Thunder's eighth game of the season. Oklahoma City is second in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and riding a one-game winning streak, while Cleveland is second in the Central, 2 games back, after a loss, and the Thunder lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 117-112 win in Cleveland on November 2. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Jaylin Williams is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision, while Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness).
